title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-16
content:
Weekly sync agenda — serving-runtime / infra / console (Mon 2026-03-16)

Purpose: quick alignment across serving runtime, infra, and console teams; unblock rollouts; track action items and owners. Keep to 45 minutes.

Attendees (expected): Morgan Lee (owner), Ari Miller, Sanjay Patel, Elena Garcia, Priya Nair (SRE), Tom Becker (Console PM)

Pre-reads: PR 1284 (runtime kernel selection fixes), Linear INF-482 (autoscaler bug), console rollout notes (confluence link above)

Agenda (45 min total)
1) Quick round (5m) — 30s per person: top priority this week, one blocker if any
   - Morgan: prioritize model-variant fallback tests for canary 2
   - Ari: finishing kernel-selection perf regression investigation
   - Sanjay: infra autoscaler tuning for dedicated pools
   - Elena: console rollout dashboard for per-route latency

2) Metrics snapshot (5m) — Priya
   - P50/P95/P99 token latency trends (last 7 days) — slight uptick p99 on 512-seq models
   - Error rate: 0.08% 5xx, spike on 2026-03-14 tied to autoscaler churning
   - Throughput: dedicated pool utilization 78% (target 70–85%)

3) Blocking issues / escalations (10m)
   - Autoscaler instability (INF-482) — Sanjay to summarize root cause: race between node termination and request draining.
   - Kernel-selection perf regression (PR 1284) — Ari to present quick diff and perf numbers.
   - Console rollout: some routes not showing token-level cost breakdown due to missing ingestion for legacy logs — Elena to propose temporary fallback.

4) Canaries & rollouts (10m) — Morgan / Tom
   - Canary 2 (model-variant fallback) planned Thu 2026-03-19. Checklist: smoke tests, fallback behavior, alerting.
   - Rollback criteria: >5% error increase OR p99 increase >30% for 10m window.

5) Action-item review & new assignments (10m)
   - Review open items from last week (see action-items list below)
   - Assign new items and clear ownership

Action-items (tracking)
- INF-A1: Autoscaler race fix — Sanjay Patel — due 2026-03-18 — description: implement safer drain handshake + add e2e that simulates node termination during heavy load. Linked: INF-482, PR draft in infra repo.
- INF-A2: Add temporary throttle on control-plane scale-down to reduce churning — Priya Nair — due 2026-03-17 — description: config flip in infra to guard against back-to-back scale downs.
- RUNTIME-A1: Kernel selection perf revert patch + perf regression test — Ari Miller — due 2026-03-17 — description: finalize PR 1284, run 1000-run perf harness for 512-seq, attach results to PR.
- CONSOLE-A1: Fallback dashboard pipeline for legacy logs — Elena Garcia — due 2026-03-18 — description: implement ingestion shim that maps legacy fields to new schema; add temporary badge on route pages.
- CANARY-A1: Canary 2 checklist & runbook updates — Morgan Lee / Tom Becker — due 2026-03-18 — description: update runbook with alert thresholds and rollback steps; prep post-canary validation queries.

Open items from previous week (status)
- INF-Prev1: Autoscaler metrics gap — in progress (Priya) — ETA 2026-03-17
- RUNTIME-Prev2: KV cache memory leak investigation — blocked on repro; Ari to follow up with infra team for synthetic load repro.

Notes / Decisions expected
- If autoscaler fix cannot be shipped by 2026-03-18, postpone Canary 2 by one week. Decision owner: Morgan Lee.
- Approve temporary throttle on scale-down this week (Priya/Sanjay) — quick config rollback path required.

Parking lot (if time)
- Long-term: move per-route cost calc to streaming pipeline to reduce console ingestion CPU.
- Investigate model shard placement heuristics to reduce cross-GPU KV cache thrash.

Prep checklist for attendees
- Bring updated perf numbers (Ari) and infra logs around 2026-03-14 spike (Priya).
- Console: list of affected routes and sample logs (Elena).
- PM: confirm acceptance criteria for Canary 2 (Tom).

Quick SCRATCHPAD (notes to self)
- Re-run perf harness with larger batch sizes; check allocator changes from PR 1279.
- If INF-A1 blocks canary, push incremental canary that excludes 512-seq heavy workloads.
- Follow up w/ Security on KMS key rotation schedule (affects private deploy smoke tests).

Next sync: Mon 2026-03-23 (same time)

-- Morgan
